2026: basic exclusion amount $15,000,000 per person ($30,000,000 for a married couple using portability), applicable credit $5,945,800. Annual gift exclusion $19,000 per recipient ($38,000 with gift splitting). Gifts to a non-citizen spouse: $194,000 a year. The 2026 amount comes from P.L. 119-21 sec. 70106; the TCJA sunset did not happen.

Federal estate and gift tax only. State estate and inheritance taxes are not included. General information, not legal or tax advice; Forms 706 and 709 and their instructions decide the official amounts.
